description: This file is a shell script for managing prplMesh processes and configurations, including starting, stopping, restarting services, handling logs, and modifying configuration parameters.

methods.name: send_signal_to_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Sends a specified signal (default TERM) to a named prplMesh process using start-stop-daemon.

methods.name: start_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Starts a prplMesh process with the given program name.

methods.name: stop_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Stops a prplMesh process by sending a signal, with a timeout, and force kill if necessary.

methods.name: roll_logs_function
methods.description: Rolls logs by creating a lock, cleaning up old log files, and signaling processes to rotate logs.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: odl_get_str_param
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from specified ODL configuration files.

methods.name: odl_set_param
methods.description: Sets a parameter in ODL configuration files, supporting string and boolean types.

methods.name: ensure_platform_db
methods.description: Ensures the platform database file exists, copying it if necessary.

methods.name: certification_mode_to_num
methods.description: Converts a human-readable certification mode to a numeric value.

methods.name: set_management_and_certification_mode
methods.description: Configures management and certification modes by editing configuration files and parameters.

methods.name: start_func
methods.description: Starts prplMesh services according to the configuration mode.

methods.name: stop_func
methods.description: Stops prplMesh services by signaling and terminating processes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point, handles command-line arguments to control prplMesh processes.
